race.title: Ladbrokes Get Your Free Racing Bet Today Mares' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: PORTER IN THE PARK is lurking on a dangerous mark and can go 2 places better than in last year's renewal of this race. The main danger could be Easy Love , who is relatively unexposed in handicaps, while That's Nice is entitled to be in the mix if on another going day. Likeable mare Love of Neymore deserves an honourable mention in an open-looking event. PORTER IN THE PARK (IRE) EASY LOVE (IRE) THAT'S NICE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: That's Nice (11/4), Love Of Neymore (5/1), Smugglers Haven (11/2), Popova (6/1), Porter In The Park (15/2), Easy Love (8/1), Letterston Lady (10/1), Miss Goldfire (10/1), Jalisco Star (20/1), Betty's Daisy (33/1)
